children: Fitch warns Tesla (TSLA) plans heavy capex that may drive midterm free cash flow negative and boost debt levels, citing a large upcoming investment cycle.
Fitch issued Tesla (TSLA) a first-time BBB issuer default rating with a stable outlook, marking Fitch’s initial standalone investment-grade credit assessment of Tesla’s corporate creditworthiness.
Tesla (TSLA) faces a California bench trial alleging racial harassment, pay and promotion bias at Fremont; company denies wrongdoing. Shares rose about 3% to $375.17 during the proceedings.
Tesla (TSLA) audited Chinese suppliers Tuopu, Sanhua and Joyson — vendors of actuators and joint modules — ahead of Optimus mass production. Fremont set for production; plan up to 1M units/year.
Fitch says Tesla's EV business should stay highly profitable, but margins may slip as Tesla boosts AI investment—trading note: higher AI spending could pressure near‑term earnings.
Tesla (TSLA) says FSD v15 is a major software upgrade; ~40% of its seven-track architecture is live in Austin robotaxis. HW4 can support unsupervised driving; target robotaxi cost ~$0.30/mile.
Tesla (TSLA) says Optimus Gen 3 design is finalized but production ramp is delayed; external sales now expected potentially in H2 2027, extending the timeline to scale the robot.
Tesla (TSLA) Powerwalls delivered ~517 MW in a 580 MW distributed battery dispatch to California on Sept 9, 2026. About 110,000 Powerwalls participated; ~55% were Sunrun-owned.
Tesla (TSLA) got Czech provisional approval to roll out Full Self-Driving after extra EU data and safeguards. Czech rollout is expected soon; TSLA stock rose about 2.7% on the news.
Tesla (TSLA) faces a California lawsuit with potential multi‑million dollar damages; legal risk adds to ongoing regulatory challenges but isn’t expected to outweigh core earnings drivers.
